msg: The aim is always to press the space bar whenever you see the basket.  That is vital.  Try to keep to one side for a while and as you go through the numbers you see a pattern emerge.  Always click on the one side even though the number may be small, eventually the number gets bigger and stays bigger for a while.  When you have had a run of good numbers switch to the other side.  I found that clicking K was most beneficial for me as although I hit some small numbers, I hit much more higher numbers.  I looked at the hats of the figures and for a while clicked only either pointy or flat hats.  This worked a for a little while but then I found it more beneficial to stick to one side at a time, regardless of the type of hat.
